target_buyer.organization: Ashtabula County Department of Job and Family Services (ACDJFS)
target_buyer.why_top_candidate: Administers SNAP, Medicaid, cash assistance, child care, and adult protective services. Eligibility Pro tools would streamline intake, reduce caseworker workload, and provide advanced features like multi-program screening and document management.

actual_brand_research.mission: Provide superior service, promote well-being and self-sufficiency, alleviate conditions of poverty, and improve health and safety

brandkit_for_mvp.proposed_tagline: Streamlined Eligibility. Faster Decisions. Better Outcomes.
brandkit_for_mvp.positioning: The professional eligibility platform for Ashtabula County JFS — empowering caseworkers with multi-program screening, document management, and workflow automation.

visual_direction.hero_image_concept: Caseworker using modern digital tools to help clients
visual_direction.color_scheme: Deep professional blues with efficient teal accents
visual_direction.photography_style: Professional office environment, client consultations, digital workflows

implementation_recommendations.brand_alignment: Align with ACJFS mission of superior service and efficiency
key_features_needed: Multi-program eligibility calculator (SNAP, Medicaid, cash, childcare, WIC)
